title: I Interviewed The Creator Of LLVM, Clang, Swift, and Mojo
summary: ThePrimeagen interviews Chris Lattner, creator of LLVM, Clang, Swift and Mojo, with TJ DeVries, in a long live-streamed conversation. They discuss language design and Lattner's experience building Swift.
why: Cited in Swift discussions for Lattner's account of Swift becoming complex too fast under pressure from Apple's needs.

quote.text: Lattner thinks Swift has become too complex too fast, due to the pressure of a rapidly growing user base.
